mission.name: Nile Delta Watch

orbit.name: Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
orbit.note: The 500 km altitude reuses the project's existing educational baseline. No orbital inclination or exact local-time orbit has been selected.

mission.purpose: Use simulated Earth-observation images to help players investigate changes in the Nile Delta's coastline, wetlands, agricultural land, and expanding built-up areas.

scenario.description: A short educational mission in which the player plans observations of selected Nile Delta areas, stores the generated image data, and downlinks it during simulated ground-station opportunities.
scenario.dataSource: Synthetic gameplay events and values; this mission does not ingest live satellite imagery.

objectives.title: Observe coastal change
objectives.description: Compare simulated observations of selected coastal areas near Rosetta and Damietta.
objectives.scientificBasis: Satellite-image time series have been used to study shoreline change along the Nile Delta.

objectives.title: Observe northern lakes and wetlands
objectives.description: Identify visible differences in open water, wetland vegetation, and surrounding land use near Lake Manzala.
objectives.scientificBasis: Copernicus Sentinel-2 imagery is used to observe the Damietta branch, Lake Manzala, agricultural land, aquaculture, and coastal ecosystems.

objectives.title: Track agricultural and urban land patterns
objectives.description: Compare simulated image scenes to distinguish cultivated areas from expanding built-up areas.
objectives.scientificBasis: NASA Earth Observatory has documented changes in farmland and urban areas around the Nile Delta using Landsat imagery.

objectives.title: Deliver observation data
objectives.description: Store collected image data onboard and transmit it during simulated communication opportunities.
objectives.scientificBasis: Gameplay objective; not a measured result from a real spacecraft.

spacecraftSize.source: CubeSat Design Specification Rev. 14.1; see the existing src/data/mission_data.json.

targetWetMassKg.note: Reuses the existing LUNAFORGE target. It is not the measured mass of a built satellite.

orbitAltitudeKm.note: Reuses the existing LUNAFORGE baseline; it is not a universal orbit for Earth observation.

powerBudget.note: These are the project's simplified gameplay values. Do not treat them as measured spacecraft performance.

batteryEnergyWh.note: Reuses the existing project baseline. The existing mission_data.json explains that the energy estimate depends on an assumed nominal pack voltage and should be checked against the exact vendor datasheet.

budgetCredits.note: Credits are in-game points, not USD.

minimumPriorityAreasObserved.note: A mission-design target only. The current engineering engine does not yet validate observation-area count.

minimumDataDownlinkedPercent.note: A mission-design target only. The current simulation does not yet calculate a data-downlink percentage.

cameraResolutionMetersPerPixel.note: Do not claim a camera resolution until a real payload specification or an explicitly labeled gameplay model is added.

dataQualityRules: This is an educational mission scenario, not a flight-ready spacecraft design.
Research findings from Landsat or Sentinel imagery describe those missions and studies, not imagery captured by a fictional LUNAFORGE satellite.
Keep published facts, calculated estimates, and gameplay assumptions clearly separated.
Do not describe the current game camera components as having a verified ground resolution; the catalog does not specify one.
Do not describe the current simulation as processing real satellite imagery or live ground-station contacts.
Keep in-game credits distinct from real-world currency.
